description: Aggregate route, chunk, and (when loaded) webpack-stats evidence into severity-ranked, evidence-backed bundle optimizations tied to concrete Next.js actions. Every suggestion is sized in emitted on-disk bytes. Works on manifests alone; load_webpack_stats first for dedupe, shared-chunk, and package-import suggestions.

limit.description: Maximum suggestions to return. Defaults to 15.

name: suggest_optimizations
title: Suggest Optimizations
